description: Yıllara Göre Yeşil Alanlar İçin Harcanan Su Miktarı is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. Bu veri kümesi yıllara göre park ve bahçe gibi yeşil alanlar için harcanan su miktarı verilerini içermektedir. Coverage: Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Park ve Bahçeler Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include park, tüketim miktarı, yeşil alan. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
